doc: Elyms fashion 2 (alt2; knitwear with bows). Clothes_fashion2_01.png is the knit sweater, bows and cuffs; Body_fashion2_02.png and Body_fashion2_pf_02.png are the dark skirt, lace and ribbons (pf_02 is the same layout in another colourway and uses fashion2_02's _m, _n, _id, per its material instance); the fur tiles (128 px, alpha blend) are left to Remix. Converted on 2026-11-03 from the game's own texture rips (Codex's port, nte15_gmod; zips in ipg\nte_15), without AABB, applied to the four ragdolls in the active session. The game has no roughness or metallic map: its toon shader reads T_*_n (a real normal map, used as the sheet's normal_map), T_*_m (LightMap: R spec intensity, B a flat specular-size class per material) and T_*_id (ramp and matcap selector; red 0 = skin), so scripts/ue_toon_maps.py derives roughness from _m.B and _m.R, skin (ID red 0) at the standard 0.70, and metallic from the strongest spec texels whose paint is bright silver or gold. The convert rules are an interpretation (see that script's header). The PMX names Body_1/Body_2 mean the main outfit sheet here, not skin: pinned to cloth. Face, eyes and hair keep the anime-safe and class values; hair sheets and tiny alpha-blend fur tiles were left out. Shared sheets (face, eyes, Hair_hair_1) are generated by one model only.
